conditions.canvas_note: NOT unified today, and this is a real difference in cost. Measured from the saved result images on 03.11 (not from the graphs' widgets): the MOSS graph generated 1024x576 (its aspect node shows custom 1024x1024, but an incoming link overrides that widget — a stored value is not what ran; the 2052x576 file in the same folder is the source+result stitch, not a canvas), the Qwen graph generated 1049x590 (a ~0.59 megapixel crop chosen around the touched mask). The Krea2 graph resizes to 1024x576 before the latent. All three are now close to 1024x576, so the cost comparison is roughly fair — the remaining difference is the Qwen crop. Each row states the real size of the saved result image
